title: Reading Drill — Testing a marked running route — Reviewing the evidence
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: Testing a marked running route — Reviewing the evidence
passages.body:
**A** The running club committee in Brackenton received an old report about new runners joining a faster group at a blind turn. The report compared near misses at the junction, but some entries had been collected under different conditions. To check the report, reviewers returned to the training logs rather than treating the published figures as a complete record.

**B** The review covered eight weeks. In the first part of that period, the original records did not consistently include different times of day. In the later part, the recording sheet included a separate field for it. The reviewers kept readings from both periods, but marked which items were missing rather than guessing what had happened.

**C** The conclusion listed an extra sign before the bend as a possible later response. It recommended collecting another set of readings before deciding whether to use it. The new data would be published with the method, so another group could work out whether its own measurements were comparable.
